blocks.text: IRIGA CITY, CAMARINES SUR — Former Iriga City Mayor Madelaine Arlene Yorobe Alfelor has been detained while a second former city official was arrested on Tuesday (September 22). These action happened on the strength of an arrest warrant issued by the Fourth Division of the Sandiganbayan over the alleged 2022 malversation of P31 million in government funds. The warrant of arrest was issued in Aug. 26 in relation to Criminal Case No. E-SB-26-CRM-0059 that implicates Alfelor, former supervising administrative officer Ruben Salazar Delos Santos and former city treasurer Jean Aquino Bongon.
